for: COMBAT THREE's data fort (slices/fight_ground/datafort/datafort.json, BUILD 11/17zo): the names its handoff asked for, the garage's format. floor.floor is the raised white floor (rows 0 to 3 of the sheet: the lift-out tiles, a perforated one here and there, scuffs), floor.high its row 4 with no marks (under the gallery's own picture, which carries the carpet tile), floor.ring every tile (the hall going on past the fight). Any tile meets any tile.

how_it_lays.a whole tile of servers (MADE, NOT IN TH: df_servers_block is what fills a server tile between its two edge rows: two more rows and the three contained aisles under their roof panels, 10.08 m wide, a tile deep, 2.2 m up, foot its south base middle. The big inside's own module lays a wall tile's 'piece' at (0.5, 0.98): the one line "piece": "df_servers_block" on the legend's 'S' and a kit line for the name, and this lane's next cut puts the picture here (tools/bohemia_cook5_the_data_fort_finished_11_18_26.py cut --block). Until then a server tile is its two edge rows with the white floor between them.
how_it_lays.the server rows: df_servers_ns is one row of twenty cabinets 1.2 m wide and a tile deep, 2.2 m up the glass, foot its south end middle: laid on both long edges of a server tile it is the pod's two rows, their lights on their tops' edges (the map's eye is over them: a cabinet's doors face east and west and are never seen, so the lights that say it is on are on its top). df_servers_ew is the pod's end a tile wide, 2 m up, foot its south base middle.
how_it_lays.the floor things: df_crates is 5 m wide (three crates, one opened), df_crates_b two more; df_floor_up is the hole and its stack, 4 m; df_desk 6 m, its screens face south; df_batteries a tile wide, 1.9 m; df_crac 6 m by 2.2 m, 2.4 m up and its pipes: foot each at its south edge middle
how_it_lays.the gate: df_gate is a tile wide, 2.4 m of mesh with the gate open in its middle 2 m (a man on the tile stands in the gap); foot its south base middle
how_it_lays.the gallery: df_gallery on every high tile, foot at the tile's south edge middle; 1.42 m up; its carpet tiles repeat every 1.2 m so deck tiles meet. df_stair_e climbs to the east, df_stair_w to the west. df_rail_ew / df_rail_ns on its open edges (the hall's glass rail).
how_it_lays.the outer wall: df_wall_ew / df_wall_ns: windowless concrete painted white, cut at 1.6 m, a tile long

ceiling.what: the slab, ladder trays of cable over every row (two a bay, north to south), the bus duct across every bay and its tap boxes, conduit, strip lights nearly all still on, red smoke heads
ceiling.contract: datafort.json 'ceiling' (COMBAT THREE's: the fight draws it over the board at that alpha, rule 451(a))
